item.title: "Both Nodes Die Together" Is a Myth: Getting the Two-Node Cluster Right
item.description:
Before committing to the cluster, the loudest warning I heard was: “a two-node cluster has no fault tolerance — lose one, lose both.” That is half right, and the wrong half decides the whole architecture. This post works through the Raft majority math and the two ways to harden the “1 leader + N replicas” shape.

What the official docs actually say
